title: ORIVS / OURO — Building a Connected Communications System
summary: An ongoing communications project connecting the OURO product story across launch communications, event branding, and investor communications.

blocks.text:
ORIVS and OURO are the named entities in this project. OURO is a personal-audio product. The work is an ongoing Detailed Group communications initiative.

The initiative explores how one product story can connect a launch, an event experience, and an investor narrative. Three workstreams sit inside that effort: OURO launch communications, NEXT '26 event branding, and investor communications.

They are one project. Product features, campaign results, and a completed outcome are not part of this account.

The communications objective is to present one product coherently to different audiences and in different contexts.

Launch communications, event branding, and investor communications do not share one audience. The objective is to keep the OURO product story recognizable across those contexts. This describes the aim of the project. It is not a confirmed history of a prior problem, and it is not a claim that a strategy has been completed.

The three workstreams are different moments for the same product story.

OURO launch communications carries the story to the audience the launch is meant to reach. NEXT '26 event branding places that story in an event experience. Investor communications presents the wider product and business opportunity.

The central narrative stays consistent. Each format still serves its own purpose. The materials used by each workstream are not confirmed here.

blocks.title: OURO launch communications
blocks.summary: The workstream that communicates OURO to its intended audience, inside the same product story as the rest of the project.
blocks.text:
Launch communications introduces OURO to the audience that the launch is meant to reach. Its role is to carry the product story alongside the event and investor workstreams.

Channels, formats, and launch performance are not confirmed. This section does not include them.

blocks.title: NEXT '26 event branding
blocks.summary: The workstream that places the OURO product story in the NEXT '26 event experience.
blocks.text:
Event branding gives the same product story a place in the NEXT '26 event. It belongs to the wider communications project alongside launch communications and investor communications.

The name NEXT '26 is used as given. Attendance, location, production scope, and execution details are not confirmed. This section does not include them.

blocks.title: Investor communications
blocks.summary: The workstream that presents the wider product and business opportunity to an investor audience.
blocks.text:
Investor communications carries the product story into a conversation about the wider opportunity. It uses the same central narrative as the launch and event work, for a different audience and purpose.

Investment figures, financial projections, funding outcomes, and presentation contents are not confirmed. This section does not include them.

Launch communications, NEXT '26 event branding, and investor communications are one project. What connects them is the product story, the different audience each moment addresses, and the need for that story to stay consistent.

The project is ongoing. It does not claim a completed commercial result.
